summary: HAY1900 price recovery after post-raise conversion and traffic break.

actions.remark: 提价后近7天广告展示点击订单断流，回调价格观察出单恢复
actions.reason: HAY1900 2026-06-08 实时广告汇总显示近7天展示/点击/订单均为0，30天仍有有效手动词组8单且ACOS 3.26%；产品分析FBA 124、30天销量23，库存已不再是硬控销状态。先从54.99小步回调到51.99恢复承接，不加广告。
evidence: adProductData live-read 2026-06-08: manual keyword campaign 30d orders=8, ACOS=3.2557%
adProductData live-read 2026-06-08: auto campaign 30d orders=1, ACOS=36.1503%

adCoupling.reason: 先修复价格承接，不同步加广告；价格恢复后只允许观察或恢复已验证手动词组，禁止扩大无效泛流量。

actions.hypothesis: 小步降回51.99后，若价格是主要阻断点，3天内应恢复曝光点击或订单，7天内至少恢复有效手动词组出单。

killSwitch.condition: If price lands but 7d orders remain 0 while ads are eligible, stop further price cuts and move to listing/front-end diagnosis.
killSwitch.rollbackIf: price lands but orders remain zero by day 7

reviewPlan.rollbackIf: If price does not land within 1 day, check application status; if 7d orders stay zero after landed price and ads remain eligible, move to listing/front-end issue review instead of further lowering blindly.
